relations.myth: Daniel receives wisdom and knowledge of dreams
relations.note: God grants Daniel exceptional wisdom, knowledge, and insight into dreams.

relations.myth: Daniel prays despite the royal prohibition
relations.note: Daniel faithfully prays to God despite the decree that leads to the lions’ pit.
God sends an angel who shuts the lions’ mouths and preserves Daniel.

relations.myth: Promise to stand at the end
relations.note: God’s revelation promises Daniel an allotted portion at the resurrection.

relations.myth: Interpretation of the ram and goat
relations.note: Gabriel explains Daniel’s vision of Media, Persia, Greece, and Antiochus.
Gabriel explains the seventy-week timetable following Daniel’s prayer.
Michael protects Daniel’s people and assists the messenger bringing Daniel revelation.
This celestial adversary delays the messenger carrying an answer to Daniel.
Daniel sees the Ancient of Days enthroned and judging the beastly kingdoms.

relations.other: One like a son of man
relations.note: Daniel sees this humanlike heavenly figure receive everlasting dominion.
Daniel refuses worship, exposes the priests’ fraud, and destroys Bel’s image and temple.
Daniel refuses to worship the cult animal and kills it with a prepared mixture.
